scope: Optional upload/download encoding for svl-sync-1 and assessment-1; acknowledged baselines and stored business snapshots remain complete.
downloadCapability: GET /api/svl/v1/account: bundleDeltaDownload=json-delta-1, with the existing chunks-1 parameters

headers.x-svl-base-revision: positive acknowledged revision of this account and entity

downloadResponse.metadata: Keep entryId or sessionId, target revision, and the original cursor/changeId when present.
downloadResponse.inline: metadata + baseRevision + delta; no bundle field
downloadResponse.chunked: metadata + baseRevision + deltaRef={digest,size,parts}; authenticated chunks-1 endpoint returns the serialized delta object, verified by digest and size before applying it
downloadResponse.fallback: Keep the original complete bundle/packetRef response when no matching base snapshot exists, no capability was requested, or a delta would not be smaller.
downloadResponse.apply: Apply only to the complete acknowledged bundle with matching account/entity/baseRevision, not current locally edited business rows. Verify target identity and size, then run existing complete validation, media persistence and merge before committing baseline/cursor.

path: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the acknowledged bundle; array indexes refer to the result of preceding operations.

semantics.set: Replace a value, or add an object member; an empty path replaces the bundle root.
semantics.remove: Remove an existing object member. Arrays use splice.
semantics.splice: Replace deleteCount array members starting at index with items; unchanged spans are retained.
semantics.omission: Unmentioned data is retained from the same account, entity and baseRevision. Omission never deletes history.

commit: Reconstruct from the matching complete current or historical snapshot, then run the existing complete bundle validation, identity, media, history retention, optimistic revision and canonical-content receipt checks. No delta is stored as the business snapshot.
fallback: Use the complete frozen request if capability or matching local baseline is absent, or the delta is not smaller. HTTP 412 with error=delta_base_missing permits a complete retry with the same changeId, baseRevision and logical content.
limits: Existing complete bundle and request limits still apply. Large delta requests reuse chunks-1. Original media remains digest-addressed. New report artifacts are complete; old report artifacts are omitted.
